title: Collect granules with a sleeve-and-notched-rod sampler
instruction: Use the closing sampling probe to collect at least 5 grams of granules from the tub into the sample jar. Leave the probe supported, the sample contained, and both hands released.
context: Laboratory formulation and materials experiments require a contained subsample of granular feedstocks. The task follows Buerkle powder sampler Mini: extend a notched collecting rod, fill it, retract it into its sleeve, then re-extend over a receiving vessel to empty. Manufacturer reference: https://www.buerkle.de/en/powder-sampler-mini_p5346-3010 . Dry calibration spheres provide a repeatable clean stand-in.
setup: Calibrated bimanual YAM station,standard parallel grippers,tabletop z=0.7475m,overview and two wrist cameras. Original sleeve-and-rod sampler:280g aluminum/polycarbonate outerframe,48x48x38mm lower sleeve with6mm chamfered mouth,270mm hollow barrel with24x24x80mm rubber grip and36mm fingerrest;85g aluminum collecting rod with40x40x23mm notched pocket,integral4mm floor,and30mm blue topbutton. Rod stroke25mm downward. Source:105x105mm inner polymer tub,145mm walls,3mm thick,at(0.40,0.02,0.7475)m. Material:1,960 separate6.8mm,0.18g polymer spheres,14x14x10 resetlattice at7.1mm pitch then settled. Jar:110x110mm inner polymer cup,95mm walls,3mm thick,at(0.22,0.10,0.7475)m. Probe starts at(0.28,-0.06,0.7535)m in a polymer cradle with116x116x6mm foot,100mm opening and30mm walls. Secondary polymer tray520x620mm inside,50mm walls,8mm base,centred at(0.40,0.16)m. Full solids/materials/transforms inREADME,setup-layout.json,scene-inventory.json;printable CAD inreconstruction/sampler.scad.
scoring: 0.4 for at least2g and less than5g eligible sample settled in the jar;0.7 for at least5g. Eligible grains enter the exposed side notch from the source,remain enclosed after rod retraction to2mm or less,then exit the exposed notch into the jar. Holding a filled sampler in the jar earns no delivery. Full1.0 adds sleeve corners inside100mm cradle opening(+0.5mm measurement tolerance),origin within5mm of supportheight,uprightcosine>0.98,extension<=2mm,probe speeds<15mm/s and0.15rad/s,both grippers>40mm open and all robot collision bodies>3mm clear,for1s. Grains belowtabletop-5mm,probe outside declaredworkarea,or nonfinite state permanently score0. README defines whole-grain/source/jar bounds.
reset_notes: Restore1,960 dry calibration spheres and fixed geometry, retract SampleSlide to0, initialize READY/open grippers, settle2.5seconds.
fidelity: The operating sequence follows Buerkle powder sampler Mini: a pushbutton extends a notched collecting rod,which retracts into a sleeve to retain material. This original reconstruction uses an enlarged rectangular pocket and clean6.8mm calibration spheres,an ordinary barrel grip/fingerrest and30mm button. Its solid floor is integral to the rod. A6mm chamfered sleeve mouth guides coarse beads inward during closure. Native rigid contacts,continuous collision detection and a constant20N/m spring with60mm preload supply the physics. Printable union CAD provides an affordable custom-tool alternative; this is not an OEM dimensional replica.
